title: Cabinet approves Upgradation of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa Section of NH-22 to 4-Lane Standard in Bihar on Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) at total Capital Cost of Rs.3590.73 crore
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved upgrading the 82.578 km Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 in Bihar to 4-lane standard under Hybrid Annuity Mode at a capital cost of Rs.3590.73 crore. The corridor connects the India-Nepal border at Sonbarsa to Muzaffarpur on NH-27, and includes seven major bridges, three railway over bridges, and two flyovers. It is designed for 100 kmph speed and aligns with the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan, linking industrial, social and logistics nodes.

title: Cabinet approves Upgradation of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa Section of NH-22 to 4-Lane Standard in Bihar on Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) at total Capital Cost of Rs.3590.73 crore
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved upgrading the 82.578 km Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 in Bihar to four-lane standard, to be built under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) at a capital cost of Rs.3590.73 crore. The corridor connects the India-Nepal border at Sonbarsa to Muzaffarpur on NH-27 (East-West Corridor), and includes seven major bridges, three railway over-bridges, and two flyovers. It is planned under the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan to improve multimodal connectivity to industrial, social, and logistics nodes.

title: Cabinet approves four multitracking projects covering eight Districts in West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, increasing the existing network of Indian Railways by about 410 Kms
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved four railway multi-tracking projects worth about Rs. 9,450 crore, spanning West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. The projects—Kharagpur-Bhadrak 4th line, Bhadrak-Haridaspur 4th line, Gummidipundi-Gudur 3rd/4th line, and Cuttack-Paradeep 3rd/4th line—will add about 410 km to the rail network across 8 districts and are to be completed by 2030-31. They are expected to enhance connectivity for around 6,448 villages with a population of about 60 lakh, boost freight capacity by 76 MTPA, and improve access to several tourist and pilgrimage sites.

title: Cabinet approves four multitracking projects covering eight Districts in West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, increasing the existing network of Indian Railways by about 410 Kms
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by PM Narendra Modi, approved four railway multi-tracking projects worth about Rs. 9,450 crore, covering eight districts in West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. The projects will add roughly 410 km to the Indian Railways network by 2030-31, including 4th lines on Kharagpur–Bhadrak and Bhadrak–Haridaspur, and 3rd/4th lines on Gummidipundi–Gudur and Cuttack–Paradeep sections. They are expected to connect about 6,448 villages with a population of 60 lakh, add 76 MTPA of freight capacity, and cut oil imports and CO2 emissions.

title: India Hosts Eighth BRICS Youth Energy Summit 2026 under its BRICS Chairship
summary: India virtually hosted the Eighth BRICS Youth Energy Summit on 17 August 2026 under its 2026 BRICS Chairship, themed 'Energy for All' within the broader BRICS theme of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability. Over 100 young energy professionals from BRICS academia, government and energy ministries, along with bodies like SEforALL, ISA and IRENA, discussed energy security, access, and technology/innovation. Indian youth representatives showcased national schemes such as PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar, RDSS, SHANTI Act and India Energy Stack, and highlighted the BRICS Digital Centre of Excellence on Smart Grids and Energy Storage.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah to chair 31st meeting of the Southern Zonal Council on 20th August 2026 in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah will chair the 31st meeting of the Southern Zonal Council on 20 August 2026 in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu. The Council comprises Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana and the UTs of Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, with Tamil Nadu CM as Vice-Chairman. The meeting, organised by the Inter-State Council Secretariat, will discuss issues like Fast Track Special Courts, Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act matters, water-sharing projects, PMAY-Gramin and civil aviation.

title: Prime Minister expresses grief over loss of lives in fire mishap in Kolkata
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over loss of lives in a fire mishap in Kolkata, conveying condolences to bereaved families and wishing speedy recovery to the injured. He noted that the local administration is assisting those affected. The statement was posted on X by the PMO in both English and Bengali.

title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO DR SHANKER DAYAL SHARMA ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
summary: President Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to former President Dr Shanker Dayal Sharma at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his birth anniversary, observed on 19 August 2026.

title: Raksha Mantri to hold bilateral talks with his Japanese counterpart in New Delhi to further deepen defence cooperation
summary: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will hold bilateral talks with Japanese Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi in New Delhi on 20 August 2026 to deepen defence cooperation, focusing on maritime security and defence equipment/technology collaboration under the 'Make-in-India' framework following Japan's revision of its Three Principles on Transfer of Defence Equipment and Technology. On 19 August, Koizumi visited the Western Naval Command in Mumbai, met Navy Chief Admiral Krishna Swaminathan, inspected a Guard of Honour, laid a wreath at Gaurav Stambh, and visited INS Chennai. The visit follows Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi's recent Delhi summit with PM Modi where both sides agreed to deepen defence ties.

title: NHRC, India takessuo motucognizance of the reported physical assault on two men from Manipur in Munirka area of Delhi
summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of a media report about the assault on two men from Manipur in the Munirka area of Delhi, allegedly following a dispute over a minor issue on 14 August 2026. One victim reportedly suffered serious head injuries and is on ventilator support. The NHRC has issued a notice to the Delhi Police Commissioner seeking a detailed report, including investigation status and the injured victim's health, within two weeks.

title: India’s Makhana Sector: Traditional Crop to Global Superfood
summary: Makhana (Euryale ferox), a traditional aquatic 'fox nut' crop of Bihar, has grown into a nationally consumed superfood and a fast-expanding agri-export sector. The government has set up the National Makhana Board (announced in Budget 2025-26, launched in Bihar in September 2025) and approved a ₹476.03 crore Central Sector Scheme for Makhana Development (2025-26 to 2030-31) to boost seed quality, processing, branding and exports. Bihar produces about 75% of India's makhana and 80-85% of global supply, with national production rising from 63,910 MT (2024-25) to an estimated 80,590 MT (2025-26), while exports in 2025-26 stood at 7,264.89 MT, mostly to the US, Canada and UAE.

title: Union Minister of Commerce & Industry Shri Piyush Goyal leaves for Singapore for 4th India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable and 4th India-Singapore Business Roundtable
summary: Union Commerce & Industry Minister Piyush Goyal visited Singapore from 19-21 August 2026 for the 4th India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR) and 4th India-Singapore Business Roundtable (ISBR), accompanied by a roughly 70-member Indian business delegation. The visit included G2B and institutional engagements, an APEDA-FairPrice initiative to promote Indian agri-food exports, a meeting with Singapore PM Lawrence Wong, and participation in the FICCI-organised India-Singapore Business Forum and ICAI ASEAN Conference. The release highlights that Singapore was India's largest source of FDI in FY 2025-26 (USD 19.8 billion) and cumulative FDI stood at USD 194.68 billion (24.72% of India's total FDI) during April 2000-March 2026, with bilateral trade rising from USD 6.7 billion (FY 2004-05) to USD 36.1 billion (FY 2025-26) after the India-Singapore CECA.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of benevolent actions and welfare of others
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X, conveying that true fulfilment of human life lies in continuously performing benevolent, welfare-oriented actions towards other beings through one's physical capabilities, wealth, intellect, and speech. The post was a social media message with no accompanying policy announcement.

title: Department of Youth Affairs To Host the BRICS Youth Council Meeting, Youth Summit and Youth Ministers’ Meeting as Part of India’s BRICS Presidency 2026

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: The Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, will host BRICS youth engagements as part of India's BRICS Presidency 2026: the BRICS Youth Council Meeting and Youth Summit on 19-20 August 2026 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, and the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting on 22 August 2026 in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. These follow earlier 2026 events including a Youth Coordination Meeting, the 'Serve BRICS' volunteering initiative (targeting 1 million volunteer hours via the MY Bharat platform), a Youth Entrepreneurship Working Group meeting in Indore, and a Youth Thematic Session. The Council and Summit will work towards a BRICS Youth Joint Statement and Cooperation Framework, while the Ministers' Meeting will adopt a Joint Ministerial Statement on Youth Cooperation.

title: Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan Delivers 2.89 Lakh Pucca Houses Worth ₹3,473 Crore to Rajasthan Under PMAY-G
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, during a visit to Baran, Rajasthan, handed Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma a sanction letter for 2.89 lakh houses worth ₹3,473 crore under PMAY-Gramin, along with ₹340.59 crore for agricultural development and PM-RKVY. He announced three major PMAY-G eligibility reforms — two-wheeler owners are now eligible, the income ceiling for eligible women was raised from ₹10,000 to ₹15,000/month, and small farmers with up to 5 acres unirrigated/2.5 acres irrigated land now qualify. He also announced doubling of Rajasthan's Lakhpati Didi target to 32 lakh, a ₹12,000 crore target for the state under the new Viksit Bharat-G RAM G Yojana, and plans for tougher pesticide and seed legislation in the next Parliament session.

title: Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan Delivers 2.89 Lakh Pucca Houses Worth ₹3,473 Crore to Rajasthan Under PMAY-G
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan visited Baran, Rajasthan, and handed Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma sanction letters for 2,89,355 houses (₹3,473 crore) under PMAY-Gramin and ₹340.59 crore for agricultural development/PM-RKVY. He announced three PMAY-G eligibility reforms — two-wheeler owners are now eligible, the income cap for women beneficiaries rises from ₹10,000 to ₹15,000/month, and small farmers with up to 5 acres unirrigated (2.5 acres irrigated) land now qualify. He also doubled Rajasthan's Lakhpati Didi target to 32 lakh and announced the new Viksit Bharat-G RAM G Yojana with a ₹12,000 crore investment target for the state.

title: Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman chairs 3rd Meeting of Apex Monitoring Authority of NICDIT and reviews the progress of projects under NICDP
summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 3rd Apex Monitoring Authority meeting of NICDIT, reviewing progress under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP), which now covers 20 approved projects across 13 states and 7 corridors. Four industrial smart cities (Dholera, Shendra-Bidkin, Greater Noida, Vikram Udyogpuri) have entered production, with 469 plots (~5,348 acres) allotted, ₹2.21 lakh crore investment potential, and 1.29 lakh employment potential. The meeting also reviewed the new Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA) scheme for 100 plug-and-play industrial parks, which received 87 applications against 20 proposed slots in its first round.

title: Ministry of MSME Joins Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026 with Enthusiasm; Celebrates 150 Years of Vande Mataram
summary: The Ministry of MSME organised a programme on 13 August 2026 to mark the Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026 (observed 9-17 August) and the 150th anniversary of the National Song 'Vande Mataram'. The Secretary, MSME, distributed the National Flag among officers and staff, who also sang Vande Mataram collectively and were encouraged to join the 'Selfie with Tiranga' initiative on harghartiranga.com.

title: India Hosts the 7th BRICS ICT Working Group Meeting in Pune to Strengthen Digital Cooperation and Future Network Technologies, guided by India’s Chairship theme, "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability"
summary: India hosted the 7th BRICS Working Group Meeting for Cooperation in ICTs in Pune, under India's BRICS Chairship, inaugurated by Department of Telecommunications Secretary Amit Agrawal. Delegates discussed AI, next-generation communications, Industry 4.0 applications, EMF exposure, and digital public infrastructure integration. The meetings continue with sessions on the Focus Group on Digital Public Infrastructure and the Digital BRICS Task Force.

title: Government Strengthens Welfare and Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities through SEED Scheme
summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment reiterated its ongoing welfare measures for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic (DNT/NT/SNT) communities through the Development and Welfare Board for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities (DWBDNC). The Board implements the Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNTs (SEED), covering four components: education (competitive exam coaching), healthcare (insurance), livelihoods, and housing assistance. The release traces the institutional background from the 2015 National Commission to the 2019 constitution of DWBDNC.

title: Central Information Commission launches upgraded Second Appeals and Complaints Portal on 17 August 2026

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: The Central Information Commission (CIC) launched an upgraded Appeal and Complaint Management System (AppCoMS 2.0) on 17 August 2026, unveiled by Chief Information Commissioner Raj Kumar Goyal. The portal, originally introduced in 2016, allows citizens to file and track Second Appeals and Complaints under the RTI Act, 2005 online. The upgrade adds user accounts for applicants and CPIOs, digital signature certificate-based order issuance, and improved document access and case-tracking features.

title: Progress of area coverage under Kharif crops as on 14.08.2026
summary: The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare released data on Kharif crop area coverage as on 14 August 2026, showing total sown area of 1016.57 lakh hectares, a decrease of 20.95 lakh hectares compared to the same period last year (1037.52 lakh ha). Rice, pulses, coarse cereals, oilseeds, sugarcane and cotton all recorded marginal to significant declines in area, while jute & mesta saw a slight increase. State-wise variations show declines concentrated in Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Odisha, with gains in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Assam for various crops.

title: ECMS Accelerates Electronics Manufacturing: 38 Plants Operational, 16 in Advanced Construction Stages
summary: The Ministry of Electronics and IT has approved 31 new proposals worth ₹6,844 crore under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS), taking the total to 106 approved projects with cumulative investment of ₹69,548 crore. Of these, 38 plants are already operational and 16 are in advanced construction stages, with the scheme expected to generate about 74,628 direct and 2.5 lakh indirect jobs across 15 states. The latest approvals mark first-time domestic manufacturing of components like filters, coils and speakers, and raw materials such as acetylene black and electrolyte additives, with domestic capacity already exceeding demand in areas like Optical Transceiver-SFP (350%) and relays (200%).

title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar calls upon Academia to strengthen informed democratic participation
summary: The Election Commission of India launched 'Electoral Literacy Clubs (ELC 2.0)' at a conference in Patna, with CEC Gyanesh Kumar unveiling a new logo and tagline ('Learn Democracy. Lead Democracy.') for the initiative. ELC 2.0 reimagines electoral literacy clubs in schools, colleges and universities as structured, digitally-enabled platforms linked to the ECINet digital portal, aiming to promote informed democratic participation among India's roughly 25 crore school students and 4.33 crore higher-education students. The CEC also met Booth Level Officers in Nalanda and conducted field visits in Bihar during his two-day visit.

title: MSDE convenes ‘Kaushal Manthan’ Regional Conference of Skill Ministers in Kolkata

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary: MSDE held the 'Kaushal Manthan' Regional Conference of Skill Ministers in Kolkata, chaired by Union Minister Jayant Chaudhary, to discuss Centre-State coordination on skilling under the PM-SETU scheme for ITI upgradation. The conference also saw the launch of an international skilling programme for 600 OBC youth from Madhya Pradesh for jobs in Japan and Germany, financed through a blended model, and updates showed over 2.10 lakh learners enrolled under the SOAR (Skilling for AI Readiness) initiative by mid-July 2026.

title: Government Strengthens Comprehensive Rehabilitation and Social Inclusion through SMILE Scheme
summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment provided an update on its SMILE (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) umbrella scheme, covering two sub-components: rehabilitation of persons engaged in begging and welfare of transgender persons. As of the latest data, 42,589 persons have been identified/surveyed and 12,710 rehabilitated under the anti-begging sub-scheme, while 23 Garima Grehs across 17 States/UTs have rehabilitated 1,041 transgender persons in three years, alongside 33,303 identity cards issued via the National Portal for Transgender Persons. A third-party NIRDPR evaluation (Sept-Oct 2025) has informed revised scheme guidelines for continuation during the 16th Finance Commission cycle (2026-27 to 2030-31).

title: India Launches First-Ever Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems at UNCCD COP17, in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: India launched its first-ever 'Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs) of India' at the UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, on 17 August 2026. Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav virtually addressed the launch event, emphasizing science-based conservation of grasslands, savannas, deserts and other open ecosystems alongside forests. The Guide, produced under MoEF&CC's guidance by ATREE with IUCN, CoE-SLM, ICFRE and ISRO's Space Applications Centre, documents India's grassland ecosystems—from Himalayan and Terai grasslands to the Thar, Banni and Deccan savannas—covering their biodiversity, associated communities, pastoralism, fire ecology and carbon sequestration.

title: From Social Opposition to a Happy Family: How Inter-Caste Marriage Incentive Support Helped ASHOK and SABITA Build a Stable Life
summary: This PIB release narrates the personal success story of Ashok Kumar Samantaray (General category) and Sabita Das (Kaibarta/SC community) from Khordha district, Odisha, who married despite initial family and community opposition due to their different caste backgrounds. Under the government's Inter-Caste Marriage Incentive scheme, they received ₹2.5 lakh in financial assistance, which they have saved for their daughter's education. The release presents this as an example of how the scheme promotes social harmony and acceptance.

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan graces Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University, Thanjavur
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan attended the Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University in Thanjavur, praising its academic contributions and reiterating that NEP 2020 guides education from KG to Ph.D. He noted India's higher education Gross Enrolment Ratio is expected to rise from 30% to 50% by 2035 and highlighted SASTRA's cybersecurity partnership with Tata Communications. He also advised students to focus on innovation and skill development while limiting social media use.

title: DFS Hosts PSB Confluence 2026: Day 1 Deliberations focus on Four themes-  Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, Supporting the Investment Cycle and Global Capability Centres
summary: On Day 1 of the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 organised by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and senior PSB/PFI leadership deliberated on four of seven identified themes: Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, Supporting the Investment Cycle, and Global Capability Centres (GCCs). Sitharaman noted historically low NPAs give banks strength for further reforms and highlighted youth (29% of India's population aged 15-29) as a key focus area, with potential collaboration explored with the Mera Yuva Bharat platform. She also indicated a High-Powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat would be announced soon, drawing on Confluence inputs. Day 2 will cover Agriculture/Horticulture Value Chain Infrastructure, Priority Sector Lending, and Reimagining Credit Cards.

title: Indian Defence Estates Service officer trainees call on Raksha Mantri
summary: Officer Trainees of the Indian Defence Estates Service (2025 Batch), training at the National Institute of Defence Estates Management (NIDEM), met Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh in New Delhi on August 17, 2026. He praised the Defence Estates Department's role in managing defence land and Cantonment Board administration, and urged the trainees to serve with 'Seva Bhav', engage regularly with citizens, and maintain physical and mental well-being through spirituality and meditation.

title: Qatar-India Postal Remittance Service based on PosTransfer powered by UPI now available through Qatar Post Outlets
summary: A new digital remittance service called 'PosTransfer powered by UPI' has been launched in Qatar, allowing customers to send money directly from Qatar Post outlets to UPI-enabled bank accounts in India. Developed jointly by Qatar Post, India Post, the Universal Postal Union's Interconnection Platform (UPU-IP), and NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL), the service went live on 15 August 2026. Transactions range from QAR 10 to QAR 4,000 (capped at ₹1,00,000 per transaction) with a flat QAR 15 service charge, and funds are credited instantly to the recipient's UPI account.

title: Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Shri Bandi Sanjay Kumar inaugurates 48 newly constructed family quarters at Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) campus in Ibrahimpatnam, Hyderabad.
summary: Union MoS Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar inaugurated 48 new Type-III family quarters for Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) personnel at Ibrahimpatnam, Hyderabad. The release notes that 10,029 SSB housing units have been completed to date with 1,273 more under construction, and highlights SSB's role in guarding the roughly 2,450-km open India-Nepal and India-Bhutan borders, having rescued 661 human trafficking victims and arrested 6,324 offenders in 2025-26.

title: Technology-Driven Pension Services Bring Greater Efficiency, Save Manpower and Resources: Dr. Jitendra Singh

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh presided over the 9th National ANUBHAV Awards Ceremony 2026 and the 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshop at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi, honouring five awardees and jury award recipients for sharing valuable service experiences. He highlighted technology-driven pension reforms such as Digital Life Certificate, Face Authentication, Bhavishya portal and Pension Adalats, and released a Handbook on Pension Mitra along with Digital Life Certificate Campaign-5 guidelines. The workshop brought together around 800 officials retiring in March 2027 to brief them on pension benefits, CGHS, and other retirement-related matters.

title: PRESS NOTE ON PERIODIC LABOUR FORCE SURVEY (PLFS) MONTHLY BULLETIN July, 2026
summary: The NSO's July 2026 Monthly PLFS Bulletin shows overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for persons aged 15+ rising to 55.4% from 54.4% in June, with gains in both rural and urban areas and a notable jump in female LFPR to 34.4%. Worker Population Ratio (WPR) also improved to 52.5%, its first rise since February 2026, while overall Unemployment Rate (UR) declined to 5.1% from 5.5%. The estimates are based on the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach and a sample of 3,71,021 persons surveyed across rural and urban India.

title: From PhD Challenges to Semiconductor Research: How National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Scheme Supported SANGEETA DAS’s Academic Journey
summary: This PIB release is a human-interest profile of Sangeeta Das, a Scheduled Caste scholar who used the National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste (NFSC) students scheme to complete her PhD while facing family and financial challenges. She received ₹31,000 per month under the scheme starting November 2020 and now works as a Project Associate II under MeitY's Chips to Startup Programme in semiconductor research.

title: From Contractual Sanitation Work to Self-Employment: How Swachhta Udyami Yojana Supported Satish Kumar’s Journey Towards Economic Empowerment
summary: This PIB feature narrates the story of Satish Kumar, a 54-year-old contractual sanitation worker from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, who transitioned to self-employment as a Sewer Suction Machine owner-operator under the Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY) component of the NAMASTE scheme. He received a ₹5.91 lakh loan from Canara Bank and a ₹3.64 lakh capital subsidy from NSKFDC (total project cost ₹9.55 lakh), raising his monthly income from ₹13,000-15,000 to around ₹50,000, with savings of about ₹25,000 after expenses.

title: EIGHTH EDITION OF IN–USN EXPLOSIVE ORDNANCE DISPOSAL EXERCISE 2026 CONCLUDES AT SOUTHERN NAVAL COMMAND, KOCHI
summary: The eighth edition of the India-US Navy Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Exercise 2026 concluded on 14 August 2026 at the Southern Naval Command, Kochi. The bilateral exercise involved subject matter expert exchanges on IED threats, mine neutralization, and unmanned underwater systems, along with cross-training in diving disciplines like wreck location, salvage, and slithering operations.

title: LOKAYAN 2026 – INDIAN NAVAL SHIP SUDARSHINI CONCLUDES PORT CALL AT PONTA DELGADA
summary: INS Sudarshini, the Indian Navy's sail training ship, concluded a port call at Ponta Delgada, Azores, on 16 August 2026 as part of the Lokayan 2026 deployment, holding cultural and professional exchanges with the Portuguese Navy including reciprocal deck receptions. The ship also marked India's 80th Independence Day there on 15 August with a Colours ceremony. It has now departed for Lisbon, where it will conduct a joint Passing Exercise (PASSEX) with Portuguese Navy vessel NRP Sagres on 21 August 2026.

title: Bharat Taxi
summary: Bharat Taxi, India's first cooperative-led ride-hailing platform, was established on 6 June 2025 under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002, by eight national cooperative institutions including NCDC, IFFCO, NABARD, KRIBHCO, Amul, NAFED, NDDB and NCEL. It operates on a zero-commission, surge-free model where drivers (called 'Sarathis') become member-owners by purchasing shares, retaining most fare earnings while a share funds their cooperative capital. As of 25 July 2026, the platform has nearly 8 lakh registered Sarathis and about 41 lakh customers across cities like Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Jaipur, and Pune, with plans for nationwide expansion by 2029.

title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan to Lead ‘Sapt Dhara of Shakti’ Pledge at Pusa on August 18
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will administer a 'Sapt Dhara of Shakti' pledge to Agriculture and Rural Development ministry officials at Pusa, New Delhi on August 18, 2026, following PM Modi's Independence Day announcement of this seven-point agenda. The event will discuss expanding the Lakhpati Didi programme from 3 crore to a target of 6 crore women, along with roadmaps for farmer welfare, food processing and export markets, involving farmers, exporters and food processors.

title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan to Lead ‘Sapt Dhara of Shakti’ Pledge at Pusa on August 18
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will administer a 'Sapt Dhara of Shakti' pledge to Agriculture and Rural Development ministry officials at Pusa, New Delhi on August 18, 2026, following PM Modi's Independence Day announcement of seven priority areas for agriculture and rural development. The event will focus on expanding the Lakhpati Didi programme from 3 crore to a new target of 6 crore rural women, alongside roadmaps for food processing, farmer welfare, and market access initiatives like She-Marts.

title: Beyond the Numbers: Decoding India's School Education Progress
summary: The Ministry of Education released the UDISE+ 2025–26 report, covering 14.67 lakh schools, 1.03 crore teachers and 24.72 crore students across India. It shows an improved overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio of 24:1 (well within NEP 2020's 30:1 benchmark), rising Gross Enrolment Ratios (89.6% Middle, 71.7% Secondary), declining dropout rates, and gains in gender parity, social inclusion, and digital/physical school infrastructure. The report also notes a fall in single-teacher schools and zero-enrolment schools compared to 2024-25.

title: Prime Minister announces ex-gratia from PMNRF for the victims of the mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex-gratia compensation from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) following a mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal. The relief includes Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased person and Rs. 50,000 for those injured in the incident.

title: Prime Minister announces ex-gratia from PMNRF for the victims of the unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex-gratia compensation from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) for victims of an unspecified unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar. The compensation is Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured. The announcement was made via a PMO post on X.

title: Modi government destroyed the ISI-backed terror group Shahzad Bhatti Network, ahead of Independence Day and thwarted its plans for subversive attacks by arresting more than 200 operatives
summary: Indian security agencies conducted a coordinated multi-state crackdown on 12 August 2026 against the Pakistan-based, ISI-backed 'Shahzad Bhatti Network' (SBN) ahead of Independence Day, detaining 253 people across 14 states. Cumulatively, over 80 FIRs and more than 200 arrests have been recorded against the network under UAPA, BNS, the Arms Act, NDPS Act and Explosive Substances Act. Recoveries included IEDs, grenades bearing Pakistan Ordnance Factory markings, pistols, cartridges and espionage CCTV cameras, with Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi and Punjab accounting for the largest number of detentions.

title: Department of Fisheries Celebrates 80th Independence Day, Reaffirms Commitment to Empowering Fishers sector and Strengthening the Blue Economy

ministry.name: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying

summary: The Department of Fisheries celebrated the 80th Independence Day in New Delhi on 15 August 2026 with fishers and fish farmers, themed around '150 Years of Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'. It highlighted cumulative government investment of ₹39,272 crore since 2015 through schemes like PMMSY and PM-MKSSY, and organised an interaction with PM-MKSSY beneficiaries, five of whom attended an 'At-Home' reception hosted by the President.

title: MoD inks contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc for leasing of two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems for Indian Navy for 30 months
summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a Rs 1,943 crore contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) to lease two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) for the Indian Navy for 30 months. The contract was signed on 17 August 2026 in New Delhi in the presence of Additional Secretary & DG (Acquisition) A. Anbarasu. The drones are intended to boost the Navy's Maritime Domain Awareness through persistent ISR coverage over the Indian Ocean Region.

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan graces 11th Convocation of Central University of Tamil Nadu, Thiruvarur
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan addressed the 11th Convocation of the Central University of Tamil Nadu at Thiruvarur, where 1,103 graduates (616 women) received degrees and 50 Gold Medals were awarded (37 to women). He spoke on the need for lifelong learning, referred to the recently passed Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, and urged action against drug abuse.

title: Prime Minister condoles the loss of lives due to a fire tragedy in Birbhum, West Bengal
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the loss of lives in a fire tragedy in Birbhum, West Bengal, offering condolences to bereaved families and wishing a speedy recovery to the injured. He noted that the local administration is providing assistance to those affected.

title: Chief Minister of Maharashtra meets the Prime Minister
summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi on 17 August 2026. The meeting was announced via a brief social media post by the PMO with no details of the agenda or outcomes disclosed.

title: Prime Minister expresses grief over the loss of lives due to a stampede in Lakhisarai, Bihar
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the loss of lives in a stampede in Lakhisarai, Bihar, conveying condolences to bereaved families and wishing the injured a speedy recovery. He noted that the local administration is assisting those affected. The statement was made via a post on X.

title: Senior Officers from BRICS Member Countries hold discussions on Key Priorities of the Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development in New Delhi

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: On 17 August 2026, India hosted a Senior Officers' Meeting of the BRICS Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development in New Delhi, chaired by MoEFCC Secretary Tanmay Kumar. Delegates from Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and UAE discussed four priority areas under India's 2026 BRICS Chairship: sustainable lifestyles, afforestation and forest fire management, circular economy, and climate adaptation. The meeting preceded the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting scheduled for the next day in New Delhi.

title: INDIAN ARMY CONTINGENT DEPARTS FOR INDIA-THAILAND JOINT MILITARY EXERCISE MAITREE-XV
summary: An Indian Army contingent of 85 personnel, mainly from 9 Gorkha Rifles, has departed for Thailand to take part in the 15th edition of the India-Thailand joint military exercise MAITREE-XV, to be held from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani. The exercise will focus on joint counter-insurgency/counter-terrorism operations in jungle and semi-urban terrain under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, involving company-level training, field exercises and a validation exercise with the Royal Thai Army.

title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the power of collective resolve, unity, and mutual cooperation for societal progress
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X, emphasizing the importance of collective resolve, unity of mind, and mutual cooperation for national progress. He linked this ancient verse to the idea that unity and shared purpose form the foundation of India's progress and prosperity.

title: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah today inaugurated and laid the foundation for development projects worth ₹6,453 crore across 17 districts from Alwar, Rajasthan.
summary: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah inaugurated and laid foundation stones for Rajasthan government development works worth ₹6,453 crore across the state, addressing a gathering in Alwar. The event included launch of a milk processing plant, four Saras Dairy plants worth ₹274 crore, four new district cooperative banks, and disbursal of crop insurance and farmer support payments. Shah highlighted the Modi government's cumulative record of annual agricultural and cooperative sector initiatives since 2014 and MSP increases across crops.

title: Dr. Jitendra Singh to confer National Anubhav Awards 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare will hold the 9th National Anubhav Awards Ceremony and 60th Pre-Retirement Counselling Workshop on 17 August 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi, under Dr. Jitendra Singh. Fifteen awardees will be honoured for contributions to initiatives like Passport Seva Kendra and administrative technological adaptation, and a Handbook on Pension Mitra along with Guidelines for Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5 will be released.

title: From Daily-Wage Struggle to a Sustainable Grocery Business: How SJY and PM-AJAY Support Helped Ruby Devi Build a Better Future
summary: This PIB release is a human-interest profile of Ruby Devi, a Scheduled Caste woman from Vaishali, Bihar, who transitioned from daily-wage labour to running a grocery store with support from the Sustainable Livelihood Scheme (SJY/JEEViKA), PM-AJAY, and the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rozgar Yojana. Through training and cumulative financial assistance of roughly ₹75,000 across schemes, her monthly income rose from ₹2,000-3,000 to ₹15,000-20,000, and she now has assets worth about ₹1,45,640. The story also highlights her improved social standing and her children's continued education.

title: From Financial Pressure to Global Research Exposure: How National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Scheme Helped PRIYANGA G Pursue Her Ph.D.
summary: This PIB human-interest release profiles Priyanga G, a 27-year-old Ph.D. scholar from Puducherry, describing how the National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste (NFSC) scheme, which she began receiving in November 2022, helped her overcome financial and family pressures during her doctoral studies. The fellowship enabled her to purchase research materials, attend two international conferences abroad with her parents, and present work at over ten conferences within India.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates and lays foundation stones for 944 development projects worth ₹5,755 crore, covering 15 districts of Rajasthan, in Chittorgarh
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 944 development projects worth ₹5,755 crore across 15 districts of Rajasthan, and unveiled a 21-foot statue of former PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee in Chittorgarh on his death anniversary. The event featured a political speech touching on Vajpayee's legacy, tribal welfare initiatives, water supply schemes in Rajasthan, and sharp criticism of the opposition party over 'Vande Mataram' and past governance.

title: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh Emphasises early diagnosis, timely medical intervention and avoidance of unnecessary investigations as the basis of responsible patient care
summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh launched the book 'Rheumatology Essentials: A New Frontier for Aspiring Clinicians', authored by Prof. Anand N. Malaviya and Dr. Prashant Kaushik, at an event attended by senior AIIMS rheumatologists. He advocated a three-pronged clinical approach — early diagnosis, avoidance of unnecessary investigations, and timely specialist referral — for managing rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases, and stressed the need for quality medical literature in Hindi and Indian languages.

title: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh Calls for Making Diabetes Prevention a National Priority, Says Rural India No Longer Untouched by Diabetes
summary: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh inaugurated the RSSDI 'Diabetes Rural Outreach Digital Portal' and launched VISHWAS, a diabetes awareness video library, on Independence Day, calling for diabetes prevention to be treated as a national priority given rising incidence in rural India. The RSSDI (Research Society for the Study of Diabetes in India) Rural Outreach Programme has so far adopted around 30 villages across several states for awareness, screening, treatment and follow-up, with the new digital portal enabling beneficiary registration, longitudinal tracking and generation of real-world rural health data. The Minister called for cross-sector collaboration among government, academia, technology partners and local health workers to scale this into a national model for NCD management.

title: Ministry of Mines to Organise Roadshow on 8th Tranche of Critical and Strategic Mineral Block Auctions and NMEDT Workshop in Patna
summary: The Ministry of Mines is holding a Roadshow on the 8th Tranche of Critical and Strategic Mineral Block Auctions along with a Workshop on the National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT) on 17 August 2026 in Patna, Bihar. The 8th Tranche comprises 20 mineral blocks (3 Mining Lease and 17 Composite Licence blocks) covering minerals such as Graphite, Rare Earth Elements, Rare Metals, Vanadium, Gallium, Titanium, Molybdenum, Tungsten, Potash, Phosphorite and Glauconite. The event will feature presentations on the auction framework, e-auction process, NMEDT reimbursement scheme for exploration expenses, and a technical workshop on mineral exploration using the National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR).

title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan graces 22nd Convocation of SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai
summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan addressed the 22nd Convocation of SRM Institute of Science and Technology near Chennai, urging graduates to embrace 'Nation First' as their guiding principle and highlighting the role of AI, quantum technologies and research in nation-building. He cited data on the expansion of higher education institutions and women's enrolment since 2014, and expressed grief over a student's murder in Tamil Nadu linked to drug-related whistleblowing, administering a 'Say No to Drugs' pledge.

title: GENERAL DHIRAJ SETH, CHIEF OF THE ARMY STAFF EMBARKS ON AN OFFICIAL VISIT TO NEPAL
summary: General Dhiraj Seth, Chief of the Army Staff, undertook an official visit to Nepal from 17 to 19 August 2026 to strengthen India-Nepal defence cooperation. During the visit he laid a wreath at Tundikhel, received a Guard of Honour, was conferred the Honorary Rank of General of the Nepali Army by President Ram Chandra Paudel, addressed student officers at the Army Command and Staff Course, and attended an Ex-Servicemen Rally at Pokhara honouring Veer Naris and Gallantry Awardees.

title: Accidental Discharge of Licensed Weapon at Varanasi Airport
summary: On 16 August 2026, during mandatory security screening at Varanasi airport, a licensed firearm declared by a passenger traveling on Air India Express flight IX 1810 accidentally discharged, injuring two CISF/security screening personnel who were shifted for medical treatment. The passenger was detained by police, and the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS) is examining lapses in weapon-handling procedures.

title: NIELIT Launches CYBER KUSHTI 2026: National Cybersecurity & AI Hackathon scores judgment rather than detection speed
summary: NIELIT, under MeitY, launched CYBER KUSHTI 2026 on 15 August, a national cybersecurity and AI hackathon that tests participants' judgment in evaluating and prioritising security findings rather than speed of vulnerability detection. Conducted with the ISAC Foundation/National Security Database and CERT-In as knowledge partner, it runs in three rounds (Akhada, Dangal, Kesari) culminating in an in-person final at NCCDFI 2026 in New Delhi on 9 October 2026. Teams of three students or researchers will receive an identical, deliberately flawed security assessment package and must produce a corrected, defensible prioritisation of genuine versus false findings.

title: Prime Minister pays homage to former Prime Minister, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee at Sadaiv Atal
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid homage to former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee at his memorial, Sadaiv Atal, on the morning of 16 August 2026. Modi posted on X that Vajpayee's role in India's progress remains unparalleled.

title: DRI uncovers large-scale illegal use of SAFTA agreement in areca imports
summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has dismantled a syndicate that fraudulently imported areca nuts from Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and other South-East Asian countries into India by falsely declaring them as Bangladeshi-origin to claim duty-free benefits under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement. The month-long operation revealed a potential revenue loss exceeding Rs. 2,500 crore, led to nine arrests, and resulted in seizure of Rs. 75 lakh cash and 160 MT of areca nuts. The syndicate routed goods through an Export Processing Zone in Bangladesh, obtained fraudulent SAFTA Certificates of Origin, and used hawala channels and dummy entities to launder proceeds; a Customs Broker firm's licence has been suspended.

title: India to Host BRICS Environment Working Group Meetings at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (17-18 August 2026)

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: India will host the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on 18 August 2026, preceded by a BRICS Senior Officers' Meeting on 17 August, as part of India's BRICS Chairship 2026 themed 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. The meeting, chaired by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav, will discuss four Indian-identified priority areas: sustainable lifestyles, afforestation/forest fire management and disaster resilience, circular economy, and climate adaptation. The BRICS Environment Working Group was established in 2015, while the Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development was set up in 2024.

title: Prime Minister pays tributes to former Prime Minister, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee on his Punya Tithi
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee on his Punya Tithi (death anniversary), observed on 16 August. In a post on social media, Modi praised Vajpayee's statesmanship, vision, and focus on good governance and public welfare.

title: Union Minister of Textiles Shri Giriraj Singh Inaugurates Handloom Haat: The Handloom Experience Centre at Janpath
summary: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh inaugurated 'Handloom Haat: The Handloom Experience Centre' at Janpath, New Delhi, a three-floor facility combining handloom heritage, design, retail and enterprise. The launch featured an exhibition of 24 award-winning weavers organised by the National Handloom Development Corporation (NHDC) and 30+ brands under 'Weave The Future 5.0'.

title: Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs interacts with interns from PM Internship Scheme in New Delhi
summary: Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman interacted with 86 interns from 24 partner companies under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) in New Delhi. She discussed their experiences and highlighted how PMIS bridges the gap between academic learning and industry readiness, with several interns receiving full-time job offers after their internships.

title: Ministry of Corporate Affairs hosts the PMIS Industry Awards in New Delhi to honour leading partner companies for  creating meaningful internship opportunities for youth under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme
summary: On 14 August 2026, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs held the PMIS Industry Awards in New Delhi to recognize companies that excelled in implementing the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) during its pilot phase. Mahindra & Mahindra was named Overall Industry Champion, with PSUs like ONGC, NTPC and Western Coalfields, and private firms like Reliance, Infosys and Dr. Reddy's also honoured across categories including Pre-Internship Excellence, Internship Management Excellence, and sectoral champion awards. The event, attended by over 100 current and former interns, was part of Independence Day celebrations.

title: National Statistical Systems Training Academy of Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation celebrates “Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign" with great enthusiasm and patriotic fervor
summary: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA) under MoSPI organized a Tiranga Yatra on 14 August 2026 as part of the Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign, coinciding with the 150th year of Vande Mataram. The event, led by Additional Director General Shri R. Rajesh, involved ISS 2026 Batch Officer Trainees and NSSTA staff and concluded with the National Anthem.

title: Union Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment, Dr. Virendra Kumar Reaffirms Commitment to Inclusive Development and Empowerment of Marginalised Communities
summary: Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Dr. Virendra Kumar addressed beneficiaries of the NAMASTE, SEED and PM-AJAY schemes at Dr Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi, reaffirming the government's commitment to inclusive development of sanitation workers, Denotified/Nomadic/Semi-Nomadic communities and Scheduled Castes. He highlighted scheme features such as PPE kits, health insurance and profiling of sanitation workers under NAMASTE, skill development and women's empowerment under SEED, and the May 2026 launch of the PM-AJAY mobile app/portal for digital monitoring. He also administered a 'Pledge Against Drug Abuse' and interacted with scheme beneficiaries ahead of Independence Day.

title: President’s address on the eve of 80th Independence Day reflects the nation’s strength and inspires renewed determination for a Viksit Bharat: PM
summary: On the eve of the 80th Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised President Droupadi Murmu's address as motivating and thoughtful. He said her message reflects the nation's strength and inspires renewed determination toward achieving a Viksit Bharat (Developed India). The PM shared these remarks in a post on social media platform X.

title: Government Removes 12-Minute Advertisement Duration Cap for Television Channels
summary: The Ministry of Information & Broadcasting has decided to remove the 12-minute advertisement duration cap for television channels, which was introduced in 2006 under the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994. The decision is aimed at ensuring fair competition and ease of doing business, given the sector's transformation from 62 analog channels in 2006 to over 900 digital channels today. The change will take effect once the amendment is formally notified in the Gazette.

title: Shri Manohar Lal inaugurates the Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk as part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign
summary: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurated a Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, organised by HUDCO as part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign (9-17 August 2026). HUDCO will distribute over 5,000 national flags through this kiosk and its regional offices, with the event featuring patriotic activities and participation from school children.

title: National Commission for Homoeopathy Clarifies Regulatory Position on Cross-Practice by Homoeopathic Practitioners
summary: The National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) has issued a clarification on Regulation 36(y) of its 2022 Professional Conduct Regulations, which bars Homoeopathic practitioners from practising other systems of medicine. It clarifies that the regulation's proviso allows such practitioners to work under National Health Programmes or other Central/State government programmes, provided they have undergone the prescribed training. The NCH also cited Regulation 14(7) of the 2022 B.H.M.S. degree course regulations, which recognises the role of Homoeopathy graduates in government health facilities and national health programmes.

title: MMDR Amendment to bring long term Stability in Major Minerals Sector
summary: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 was passed by both Houses of Parliament on 13 August 2026, amending the MMDR Act, 1957 to bring long-term stability to the major minerals sector. The government has clarified that the amendment does not alter states' rights over land and minerals, does not affect state taxation on minor minerals, and preserves the existing revenue split where roughly 90% of mining taxes and statutory payments accrue to states. The Bill aims to curb unchecked and varied state-level levies (about 14 types including royalty, auction premium, DMF contribution, GST, transit fees) that inflate costs and make domestic minerals uncompetitive against imports, which stood at Rs 10,12,529 crore in FY 2025-26.

title: LIST OF HONORARY RANKS AWARDED ON THE OCCASION OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
summary: On the occasion of Independence Day 2026, the Ministry of Defence announced honorary ranks awarded to armed forces personnel, both serving and retired. These include Honorary Captain, Honorary Lieutenant, Honorary Subedar Major, Honorary Subedar, and Honorary Naib Subedar ranks, with thousands of personnel honoured across active and post-retirement categories.

title: LIST OF GALLANTRY AWARDS TO INDIAN NAVAL PERSONNEL ON THE EVE OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
summary: On the eve of Independence Day 2026, President Droupadi Murmu approved gallantry awards for Indian Naval personnel, including one Shaurya Chakra to Lt Cdr Shivam Kumar, three Nao Sena Medals (Gallantry), and four Mention-in-Despatches. The release lists the names and ranks of all awardees.

title: ADDRESS TO THE NATION BY THE HON’BLE PRESIDENT OF INDIA SMT. DROUPADI MURMU ON THE EVE OF THE 80TH INDEPENDENCE DAY
summary: On the eve of India's 80th Independence Day (14 August 2026), President Droupadi Murmu delivered her customary address to the nation, reflecting on the freedom struggle, Partition, national integration under Sardar Patel, and constitutional values. She highlighted government achievements including poverty reduction, financial inclusion, healthcare coverage, digital payments infrastructure, economic growth, women's empowerment schemes, and India's foreign policy stance, while urging environmental stewardship.

title: Union Minister Dr. Virendra Kumar Chairs 5th Meeting of National Council for Senior Citizens; Reviews Key Initiatives, Policy Issues Concerning The Welfare, Healthcare And Empowerment Of Elderly
summary: Union Minister Dr. Virendra Kumar chaired the 5th meeting of the National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC) in New Delhi, reviewing implementation of the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY), the extension of Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY health insurance to all citizens aged 60+ regardless of income, and a proposal to include Geriatric Caregiver services in the CGHS rate card. The Council also noted two new digital initiatives, the JEEVAN app and SHATAYU platform, and launched an e-book titled 'SNEHA' documenting the Department's senior citizen welfare achievements from October 2024 to June 2026.

title: Manufacturing Momentum:Building a Self-Reliant India
summary: This PIB backgrounder, released on India's 80th Independence Day, consolidates 12 years of manufacturing sector performance under 'Make in India', covering defence, electronics, semiconductors, mobile phones, pharmaceuticals, textiles, shipbuilding/maritime, and automobiles. It cites data such as manufacturing contributing 16-17% of GDP, defence production reaching ₹1.78 lakh crore in FY 2025-26, electronics production of ₹13.11 lakh crore, and new schemes like Semicon 2.0 (₹1,27,500 crore), the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (₹62,500 crore), Biopharma SHAKTI (₹10,000 crore), and a ₹69,725 crore maritime package. It frames these as evidence of India's growing self-reliance and global manufacturing competitiveness.

title: MoEFCC celebrates ‘Har Ghar Tiranga 2026’ campaign with mass singing of National Song ‘Vande Mataram’

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: On 14 August 2026, MoEFCC officials, led by Secretary Tanmay Kumar, participated in a mass singing of the National Song 'Vande Mataram' at Indira Paryavaran Bhawan, New Delhi, as part of the 'Har Ghar Tiranga 2026' campaign and the 150th anniversary commemoration of the song. This was followed by a tree plantation drive. The Ministry is also encouraging employees to upload selfies with the Tricolour on the Har Ghar Tiranga portal.

title: Union Minister of Communications Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia Inaugurates First-Ever Drone Delivery of Tiranga by India Post
summary: On the eve of Independence Day 2026, Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia inaugurated India Post's first-ever drone delivery of the national flag, from Mandi Head Post Office to Rehardhar Branch Post Office in Himachal Pradesh. The flag was handed over to an army veteran, and the event tied into the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign. The Department of Posts has plans to deploy drone-based mail transmission across 150 identified routes in Himachal Pradesh and Assam.

title: Aatmanirbhar Bharat: MoD inks Rs 1,577 crore contracts for Loiter Munition Systems for Indian Army
summary: The Ministry of Defence signed contracts worth approximately Rs 1,577 crore with TATA Advanced Systems Limited and NIBE Private Limited for the procurement of Loiter Munition Systems, along with munitions and accessories, for the Indian Army. The contracts were signed on August 14, 2026 in New Delhi in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. The systems will be procured under the Buy (Indian) category through Fast Track Procedure to strengthen Artillery Regiments' operational capability.

title: LIST OF GALLANTRY AWARDS AND MENTION IN DESPATCHES TO INDIAN AIR FORCE PERSONNEL APPROVED BY SMT. DROUPADI MURMU ON THE EVE OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
summary: On the eve of Independence Day 2026, President Droupadi Murmu approved gallantry awards for Indian Air Force personnel, including Shaurya Chakra, Vayu Sena Medal (Gallantry), and Mention-in-Despatches. The PIB release lists these award categories with detailed awardee names provided in linked PDF documents, without additional numbers or narrative in the main text.

title: President of India Awards President’s Medal for Distinguished Services & Medal for Meritorious Service
summary: On Independence Day 2026, the President of India conferred the President's Medal for Distinguished Service on Rajesh Lal, Assistant Security Commissioner at the Railway Board, and the Medal for Meritorious Service on 15 other Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) officers and staff across various railway zones.

title: LIST OF VCOAS COMMENDATION CARD AWARDEES
summary: The Ministry of Defence released a list of Indian Army personnel awarded the Vice Chief of Army Staff (VCOAS) Commendation Card on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. The announcement consists of an attached file naming the awardees, with no further details provided in the release text.

title: LIST OF COAS COMMENDATION CARD AWARDEES
summary: The Press Information Bureau released the list of Army personnel awarded the Chief of Army Staff (COAS) Commendation Card on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. The announcement consists of an attached list of awardees without further details in the release text itself.

title: HONOURS AND AWARDS ON THE OCCASION OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
summary: On the occasion of Independence Day 2026, the Ministry of Defence announced gallantry awards for Army personnel, including 3 Kirti Chakras (1 posthumous), 1 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 11 Shaurya Chakras (1 posthumous), 5 Bars to Sena Medal (Gallantry), 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry, including 5 posthumous), and 75 Mentions-in-Despatch. Citation lists were attached as accompanying files.

title: President approves 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) & 89 Mention-in-Despatches on the eve of 80th Independence Day
summary: President Droupadi Murmu approved 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) and 89 Mention-in-Despatches for Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces personnel on the eve of the 80th Independence Day, 2026. The gallantry awards comprise 9 Kirti Chakras, 1 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 19 Shaurya Chakras, 5 Bars to Sena Medal (Gallantry), 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry), 3 Nao Sena Medals (Gallantry) and 5 Vayu Sena Medals (Gallantry). The Mention-in-Despatches went to 75 Army, 4 Navy and 10 Air Force personnel for various counter-insurgency and security operations including Operation Rakshak, Hifazat, Orchid, Meghdoot and Snow Leopard.

title: Government of India Launches CBDC-Based Direct Benefit Transfer under PMGKAY in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

summary: The Government of India launched CBDC (Digital Rupee)-based Direct Benefit Transfer under PMGKAY in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli, making them the first UT/State to fully operationalize food subsidy transfers via programmable CBDC tokens to all eligible beneficiaries. Under this model, subsidy is credited directly to a beneficiary's Digital Rupee wallet instead of a bank account, and can be used only to purchase foodgrains from empanelled merchants via QR codes (smartphones) or OTP (feature phones). The initiative builds on earlier pilots in Gujarat (15 February 2026) and Puducherry (26 February 2026), and is described as the first large-scale application of CBDC in a central welfare programme.

title: Factual position on Ken–Betwa Link Project
summary: The Ministry of Jal Shakti has rebutted media reports of tribal protests ("Chita Andolan", "Jal Satyagraha") against the Ken–Betwa Link Project in Madhya Pradesh, asserting that allegations of non-payment of compensation are misleading. It states that most eligible families have received compensation under the RFCTLARR Act, 2013 and a Special Rehabilitation Package approved in September 2023, with over 88-94% of awarded amounts already disbursed as of July 2026. The project, India's first major river-interlinking initiative, aims to irrigate 10.62 lakh hectares, supply drinking water to 62 lakh people, and generate 103 MW hydropower, at an estimated cost of ₹44,604.99 crore.

title: Lok Sabha Speaker extends greetings to the nation on the eve of India's 80th Independence Day
summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla issued a message greeting the nation on the eve of India's 80th Independence Day, paying tribute to freedom fighters and calling on India's youth to embrace constitutional values and contribute to building a self-reliant, developed nation. He noted that about 65 percent of India's population is under 35 years of age.

title: Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals Celebrates Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign Ahead of Independence Day

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals

summary: The Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals observed the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign ahead of Independence Day 2026 at Kartavya Bhawan, New Delhi, led by Secretary Tejveer Singh along with senior officials. Similar events including Tiranga Rallies were held across CIPET campuses and other autonomous bodies under the Department, with participants also singing 'Vande Mataram'.

title: BSNL Greets the Nation on the 80th Independence Day; Announces New Customer-Centric Digital Initiatives
summary: On the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day, BSNL announced a bundle of customer-facing initiatives including a Re. 1 trial mobile offer, a ₹1,111/month Fibre Freedom broadband plan with 200 Mbps speed and OTT access, a revamped Selfcare app, free 'BSNL Entertainment TV' with ~500 channels, satellite phone services, extra validity on its ₹2,399 annual plan, and a partnership with Polycab for domestic manufacturing of telecom hardware. It also stated it has ordered over 26,300 additional 4G BTS sites to expand its indigenous, 5G-upgradable 4G network into more towns and villages.

title: Railway Minister Reviews Progress of Passenger Holding Areas at Anand Vihar and Udhna Stations
summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw reviewed progress on Yatri Suvidha Kendras (passenger holding areas) being built at Anand Vihar Terminal and Udhna Railway Station, aimed at decongesting platforms during festival rush. Anand Vihar's facility will be built in two phases handling 4,000 and later 7,000 passengers, while Udhna's Kendra will accommodate around 15,000 passengers. The facilities will include waiting areas, ticketing counters, toilets, CCTV, and signage, and are targeted for completion before the upcoming festival season.

title: PRESIDENT’S GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF PARSI NEW YEAR
summary: President Droupadi Murmu issued a greetings message on the eve of Navroz (Parsi New Year), extending wishes to citizens in India and abroad, especially the Parsi community. She highlighted the community's contributions to India's development through enterprise and philanthropy, and expressed hope that the festival inspires unity towards an inclusive, developed India.

title: Railway Minister Leads Tiranga Rally at Rail Bhawan on the Eve of Independence Day
summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw led a Tiranga Rally at Rail Bhawan on 14 August 2026, the eve of Independence Day, joined by the Railway Board Chairman, Board Members and senior officials. Indian Railways is participating in the nationwide 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign, integrated with the third phase of the 150 years of 'Vande Mataram' commemoration, through events including a quiz, a patriotic songs programme, and a mass singing of 'Vande Mataram'.

title: Partition was one of the largest mass migrations in human history, says Vice-President on the occasion of Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
summary: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan addressed a National Seminar on Partition Horrors Remembrance Day (14 August), organised by Delhi University's Centre for Independence and Partition Studies with the ICHR, describing Partition as one of the largest mass migrations in history and a division of a shared civilisational heritage. He felicitated 15 Partition survivors, administered a 'No Drugs' pledge to students, and viewed an exhibition on Partition's human cost.

title: NHRC, India’s Online Short-Term Internship Programme for August 2026 concludes
summary: The NHRC's two-week Online Short-Term Internship Programme (OSTI) for August 2026, which began on 3 August 2026, concluded with 96 university students completing it, selected from 2,036 applicants across 21 states and union territories. NHRC Member Smt. Vijaya Bharathi Sayani delivered the valedictory address, urging interns to use their skills for society's larger good and uphold constitutional values. Winners of internal competitions like book review, group research presentation and declamation were also announced.

title: Ministry of Steel to hold Open House on Steel Import Issues on 21st August
summary: The Ministry of Steel will hold an Open House on 21 August 2026 at its Delhi office to address stakeholder issues related to steel import processes, specifically SIMS, SARAL SIMS, and QCO exemptions. Companies and associations must register by emailing tech-steel@nic.in by 18 August 2026, 2:00 PM, providing specified details, to receive a confirmed time slot. Walk-ins are not permitted, and only one representative per organisation may attend.

title: Military modernisation driven by a self-reliant & future-ready defence sector is Govt’s top priority: Raksha Mantri on the eve of 80th Independence Day
summary: On the eve of the 80th Independence Day (2026), Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh highlighted India's defence modernisation achievements: domestic defence production rose from Rs 46,000 crore (2014) to Rs 1.78 lakh crore (FY 2025-26), while defence exports surged from Rs 686 crore to Rs 38,424 crore over the same period, with a target of Rs 50,000 crore by 2029. He also cited a rising defence budget (Rs 7.85 lakh crore for FY 2026-27), procurement reforms, successful tests of strategic systems including MIRV-equipped Agni missile, Kusha air defence system, and a scramjet combustor test for hypersonic technology, and welfare measures for ex-servicemen and women in the armed forces.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission Clocks Seven Years of Rural Transformation: Rural Drinking Water Tap Coverage Surges from 16.7% to Over 82%
summary: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM), launched on 15 August 2019 to provide Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household, completed seven years on the eve of Independence Day 2026. Rural tap water coverage has risen from 16.72% (3.23 crore households) at launch to over 82.24% (15.91 crore households) now, with 2.04 lakh villages, 1.01 lakh Gram Panchayats, 1,090 blocks and 188 districts certified 'Har Ghar Jal'. The Union Government has extended JJM till December 2028, with JJM 2.0 now emphasising source sustainability, community ownership, water quality monitoring and long-term functionality through initiatives like Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari: Catch the Rain.

title: MSDE convenes India-Japan Stakeholder Consultation to strengthen skilling and workforce pathways between the two countries

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary: MSDE convened an India-Japan Stakeholder Consultation on Skill Development in New Delhi on 14 August 2026, bringing together Indian and Japanese government officials, industry representatives, and training partners to advance the Action Plan for India-Japan Human Resource Exchange and Cooperation released at the 2025 Annual Summit. The consultation reviewed existing pathways like the Technical Intern Training Programme (TITP) and Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) scheme, and discussed readiness for the upcoming Employment for Skill Development Programme (ESDP). A key outcome was the decision to develop a comprehensive India-Japan Skills Roadmap under MSDE's leadership to integrate candidate mobilisation, language training, assessments, and employer engagement.

title: NITI Aayog releases report on India’s Services Sector: Insights on Regulatory Regime in Professional Services
summary: On 10 August 2026, NITI Aayog Vice Chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri launched the third report in the Services Thematic Series, titled 'India's Services Sector: Insights on Regulatory Regime in Professional Services'. The report benchmarks India's regulatory framework for professional services against select foreign jurisdictions and proposes a four-pronged strategy—leveraging emerging trends, elevating professional services in the value chain, adopting best practices, and continuous professional development—to strengthen the sector. It notes professional services account for nearly a quarter of India's total services exports.

title: India's Defence Strength
summary: This Independence Day backgrounder from the Ministry of Defence summarises a decade of reforms under Atmanirbhar Bharat, citing a 3.1-fold rise in the defence budget (₹2.53 lakh crore in 2013-14 to ₹7.85 lakh crore in 2026-27), record indigenous defence production of ₹1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26, and a 56-fold jump in defence exports (₹686 crore to ₹38,424 crore) reaching 80+ countries. It also lists key institutional reforms (DAP 2020, DPM 2025, draft DAP 2026), innovation schemes (iDEX, ADITI, TDF), indigenisation platforms (Positive Indigenisation Lists, SRIJAN-DEEP), defence corridors in UP and Tamil Nadu, and major indigenous platforms such as Tejas Mk-1A, LCH Prachand, Agni-4/5, and several Navy warships. Government targets are ₹3 lakh crore in annual production and ₹50,000 crore in exports by 2029.

title: LIST OF IAF HONORARY RANKS AWARDED ON THE OCCASION  OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
summary: The Ministry of Defence released the list of Indian Air Force personnel awarded Honorary Commission ranks on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. This includes 82 personnel granted the Honorary Flight Lieutenant rank, 328 granted the Honorary Flying Officer rank, and 7 given the Honorary Flying Officer rank on retirement.

title: Strengthening India’s Space Sovereignty
summary: This PIB backgrounder, released on India's 80th Independence Day, consolidates India's space sector achievements and reforms: private space start-ups grew from 1 in 2014 to ~440 in 2026, the space economy is valued at USD 9 billion and projected to reach USD 40-45 billion in a decade, and key reforms include the Indian Space Policy 2023, liberalised FDI norms, and financing schemes via IN-SPACe and NSIL. It also outlines India's mission roadmap including Chandrayaan-4/5, Gaganyaan, the Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS), Venus Orbiter Mission, and NavIC expansion, alongside next-generation propulsion and reusable launch vehicle technologies.

title: NHAI Opens Enrolment for Winter Internship Programme 2026-27 and Term Internship Programme 2027
summary: NHAI has opened enrolment for its Winter Internship Programme 2026-27 (December 2026-January 2027) and Term Internship Programme 2027 (January-June 2027), offering over 1,080 internship positions across 125 ongoing National Highway projects and NHAI/IHMCL divisions. Eligible final-year and pre-final-year students from various disciplines can apply via the NHAI Internship Portal by 20 October 2026, with a stipend of Rs. 20,000 per month and seats reserved for IIT and NIT students.

title: Sashakt Nari, Sashakt Bharat
summary: This PIB backgrounder, released on Independence Day 2026, consolidates India's flagship schemes for women's empowerment under the theme 'Sashakt Nari, Sashakt Bharat'. It covers life-cycle interventions spanning maternal and child health (BBBP, PMMVY, PMSMA, JSSK), education (Samagra Shiksha, KGBV, Vigyan Jyoti), skilling (PMKVY, NAVYA), financial inclusion (Sukanya Samriddhi, DAY-NRLM, Lakhpati Didi, Jan Dhan, Mudra), health coverage (Ayushman Bharat, Mission Indradhanush), housing (PMAY), safety (Mission Shakti), and political representation (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, Panchayati Raj, NDA). It presents updated statistics as of mid-2026 for each scheme's reach and outcomes.

title: Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan Launches CBDC-Based DBT in Chandigarh, Paving the Way for Greater Transparency in PDS
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched a pilot Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)-based Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system for the Public Distribution System (PDS) in Chandigarh, aimed at enabling secure, transparent transfer of foodgrain subsidy funds to beneficiaries. The system includes technological safeguards restricting use of transferred funds to purchase of foodgrains and essential food items (with added choice of pulses besides wheat and rice), and is intended as a model for potential nationwide rollout. The event also featured remarks on PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana, PM-KISAN, and government commitments on farmers' interests and trade agreements.

title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to Visit Tamil Nadu on August 16–17
summary: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan will visit Tamil Nadu on August 16-17, 2026, attending convocations at SRM Institute of Science and Technology and the Central University of Tamil Nadu, a book release, a jubilee celebration at SASTRA University, and the first death anniversary of former Governor La. Ganesan. The visit spans Chennai, Chengalpattu, Thiruvarur and Thanjavur.

title: Raksha Mantri interacts with Indian Army contingent which bagged 16 medals, including 08 Gold, at Commonwealth Games 2026
summary: Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh met the Indian Army contingent that won 16 of India's 39 medals (8 Gold, 7 Silver, 1 Bronze) at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, with the Navy contributing 2 more medals for a total of 18 defence forces medals. He praised the athletes, noted several historic firsts including India's first CWG medals in Judo and Para Shot Put, and highlighted women boxers winning 4 of 6 Gold medals in boxing.

title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA GRACES THE OPENING OF AMRIT UDYAN SUMMER ANNUALS EDITION, 2026
summary: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Summer Annuals Edition 2026 of Amrit Udyan at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 14 August 2026. The garden will be open to the public free of cost from 16 August to 15 September 2026, between 10 AM and 6 PM (last entry 5 PM), closed on Mondays. Visitors must book slots online in advance via the Rashtrapati Bhavan website, with shuttle service available from Central Secretariat Metro Station.

title: DFS Highlights Mechanism for Timely Redressal of Insurance Policyholders’ Grievances
summary: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) highlighted the mechanism available to insurance policyholders for grievance redressal, emphasizing a two-tier escalation path: first to the insurer's Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO), and then to IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal if unresolved. Insurers must acknowledge complaints immediately and resolve them within 14 days, while IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal integrates complaint tracking across the industry and offers multilingual (12 languages) toll-free helpline and email support.

title: CCRAS-NIIMH Signs MoU with Sevadhi Museum and Indological Research Institute for Digitization of Medical Manuscripts
summary: NIIMH (under CCRAS, Ministry of Ayush) has signed an MoU with the Sevadhi Museum & Indological Research Institute (SEMIRI) in Kottayam, Kerala, to digitize and prepare a descriptive catalogue of SEMIRI's collection of over 30,000 manuscripts, including hundreds of Ayurvedic medical manuscripts. CCRAS-NIIMH will provide technical expertise for digitization and cataloguing following the Ayush Manuscripts Advanced Repository format, and on-site digitization has already begun. The initiative is framed as part of the government's Gyan Bharatam Mission and broader efforts to preserve India's manuscript heritage.

title: Revitalising India's Cultural Heritage
