summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited applications for direct recruitment to various posts in the Government of India under Advertisement No. 10/2026. The detailed advertisement and application instructions are available on the UPSC website, and candidates can apply online via the ORA portal from 8th to 28th August 2026, with an extended deadline of 4th September 2026 for posts under the UT of Ladakh.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising on truthful and authentic information
summary: The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (verse) on social media platform X on 10 August 2026, emphasising that information disseminated to the public should be truthful, authentic and in public interest. The verse, drawn from Vedic tradition, speaks of hearing and seeing auspicious things and living a life devoted to the welfare ordained by the gods.

title: CHIEF OF THE NAVAL STAFF ON AN OFFICIAL VISIT TO MAURITIUS TO STRENGTHEN BILATERAL MARITIME COOPERATION
summary: Admiral Krishna Swaminathan, Chief of the Naval Staff, is on a four-day official visit to Mauritius from 10 to 13 August 2026 to strengthen bilateral maritime cooperation. He will engage with senior Mauritian leadership on maritime security, defence cooperation, capacity building and military collaboration. The visit builds on existing India-Mauritius naval engagement including joint EEZ surveillance, training exchanges, port visits and hydrographic surveys, and reflects India's MAHASAGAR vision for the Indian Ocean Region.

title: Prime Minister hosts Commonwealth Games 2026 medal winners
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hosted India's medal-winning athletes from the Commonwealth Games 2026 at his residence, 7 Lok Kalyan Marg, on 9 August 2026. He interacted with the athletes, listened to their experiences from the Games, and praised their achievements as a source of national pride that would inspire youth to take up sports.

title: ICoAS fraternity reaffirms commitment to cost optimisation for Atmanirbhar Bharat on ICoAS day 2026
summary: The Indian Cost Accounts Service (ICoAS), under the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, celebrated its Foundation Day (ICoAS Day 2026) in New Delhi on the theme 'Role of ICoAS Officers in Cost Optimization for Atmanirbhar Bharat'. Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh was Chief Guest and Secretary Defence Production Sanjeev Kumar was Guest of Honour, while Expenditure Secretary V. Vualnam addressed officers via video message. The event featured a commemorative e-brochure release, felicitation of six young officers, and technical sessions on AI in public financial management and stress management.

title: Prime Minister urges people to participate in Har Ghar Tiranga movement
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to actively participate in the Har Ghar Tiranga movement, calling it a step towards realising the vision of a Viksit Bharat. He noted that this year's campaign is dedicated to Vande Mataram, coinciding with the 150th anniversary of the national song. The appeal was made via a post on X, along with a link to the official Har Ghar Tiranga website.

title: Runway Excursion Incident Involving Cessna C172 trainer Aircraft at Baramati Airfield, Maharashtra
summary: A Cessna C172 trainer aircraft (VT-SEX), operated by Academy of Carver Aviation, suffered a runway excursion at Baramati Airfield, Maharashtra, on 9 August 2026 during a Circuit and Landing Emergencies training exercise. While practising a rejected take-off, the aircraft failed to stop within the paved runway and veered off beyond the threshold of Runway 29. No injuries or fatalities occurred, though the aircraft sustained damage to its propeller, engine cowling, and nose landing gear. DGCA's Air Safety team is conducting a preliminary investigation.

title: ‘The message of Nasha Mukti from Kashi must reach every village in Jalgaon’ — MoS Raksha Khadse

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: On 9 August 2026, Union Minister of State for Youth Affairs & Sports Raksha Khadse addressed a special meeting in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, via video conference, urging that the 'Nasha Mukt Yuva – Viksit Bharat' campaign be turned into a mass people's movement. The meeting brought together spiritual leaders including Mahamandaleshwar Swami Janardan Hari Ji Maharaj, public representatives, district administration, and youth and social organizations to coordinate de-addiction awareness efforts across every village in Jalgaon district.

title: INDIAN NAVY–US NAVY EXPLOSIVE ORDNANCE DISPOSAL EXERCISE 2026 TO COMMENCE AT SOUTHERN NAVAL COMMAND, KOCHI
summary: The Indian Navy and US Navy will conduct the eighth edition of their bilateral Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Exercise from 10-14 August 2026 at Southern Naval Command, Kochi. The five-day exercise involves Subject Matter Expert Exchanges, cross-training, equipment demonstrations and scenario-based drills aimed at enhancing interoperability between the specialist diving and EOD teams of both navies. The two navies have conducted joint Salvage and EOD exercises since 2005.

title: Sudden loss of altitude during cruise and injuries on board M/s Air India A320 aircraft VT-EXO operating flight AI2379 from Phuket to Delhi on 04.08.2026
summary: On 04.08.2026, Air India A320 aircraft VT-EXO operating flight AI2379 from Phuket to Delhi suffered a sudden loss of about 300 feet altitude during cruise, causing injuries to some passengers and cabin crew before the aircraft stabilised and landed safely in Delhi. The flight carried 137 passengers (including 3 infants) and 8 crew members. Post-incident psychoactive substance screening flagged the Pilot-in-Command for confirmatory testing, and both flight crew have been taken off roster by DGCA pending the outcome. The incident has been classified as a Serious Incident and is under investigation by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB).

title: Competition Commission of India (CCI) hosts BRICS Heads of Competition Authorities 2026 meeting
summary: Under India's BRICS Chairship 2026, the Competition Commission of India (CCI) hosted the Meeting of Heads of BRICS Competition Authorities on 8 August 2026 in Udaipur, Rajasthan. The Heads adopted a Joint Statement titled 'Strengthening Cooperation to Promote Fair Competition, including in Renewable Energy Markets' and reviewed a CCI-led BRICS study on competition dynamics in renewable energy markets. Brazil's CADE briefed participants on preparations for the Xth BRICS International Competition Conference scheduled for 2027.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban Milestone: 1.25 crore houses sanctioned, 1 crore houses delivered
summary: PMAY-Urban has crossed 1.25 crore houses sanctioned (across PMAY-U and PMAY-U 2.0), with over 1 crore houses completed and delivered, and 1 crore houses allotted to women. The 8th Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) meeting under PMAY-U 2.0, chaired by MoHUA Secretary Satendra Singh on 6 August 2026, sanctioned 2.09 lakh new houses for EWS families across 16 States/UTs, taking total PMAY-U 2.0 sanctions past 18.38 lakh. The meeting reviewed implementation pace, fund utilisation, geo-tagging and beneficiary verification across the scheme's verticals (BLC, AHP, ISS, ARH).

title: ‘Nasha Mukt Bharat’ the theme as Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya leads nationwide 85th edition of Fit India Sundays on Cycle from Hanol in Gujarat with youth, MyBharat, NSS

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: Union Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya led the 85th edition of 'Fit India Sundays on Cycle' from Gujarat, with this edition themed 'Nasha Mukt Bharat' (Drug Free India) under the slogan 'Say yes to fitness, Say NO to drugs.' The event, held simultaneously at over 10,000 locations nationwide including a mega event in Delhi at Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, saw more than 1,000 participants take a collective pledge against substance abuse followed by a 5-km cycling ride around India Gate and Kartavya Path. Started in December 2024, the initiative has cumulatively drawn over 30 lakh participants across India, organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports with the Cycling Federation of India, Raahgiri Foundation and MY Bharat.

title: India to be an essential player in the next industrial revolution which will be biotechnology and AI driven: Dr Jitendra Singh
summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh stated that India will be a key player in the next industrial revolution driven by biotechnology and AI, having missed the earlier IT-driven revolution. He highlighted India's BioE3 biotechnology policy, National Quantum Mission, and India AI Mission as evidence of India's shift from technology follower to leader, and noted India's space economy has grown to $9 billion, projected to reach $40-45 billion in 8-9 years.

title: India Achieves Landmark 300 GW Non-Fossil Fuel Power Capacity

ministry.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

summary: India has crossed 300 GW of installed non-fossil fuel electricity generation capacity as on 31 July 2026, comprising 164.59 GW solar, 58.14 GW wind, 57.24 GW hydro, 11.75 GW bio-power and 8.78 GW nuclear power. This represents over 60% of the 500 GW non-fossil capacity target for 2030 and over 54% of India's total installed capacity of around 552 GW. A record 55.29 GW of non-fossil capacity was added in 2025-26 alone, and domestic solar module manufacturing capacity under the ALMM list has crossed 200 GW.

title: Op Sindoor sent a global message that India will go to any extent to ensure safety of its citizens: Raksha Mantri
summary: Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh inaugurated the 'Sindoor Maharaktadan Yatra' blood donation camp at Base Hospital, Delhi Cantt on 09 August 2026, linking it symbolically to Operation Sindoor. Around 1,000 sportspersons from Maharashtra, including wrestlers and athletes, were among the donors, with nearly 500 voluntary donors participating overall. Singh described the blood collected as a future reserve for soldiers and their families and called blood donation 'Jivandan' and 'Mahadan', urging youth to adopt it as a culture alongside fitness initiatives like Khelo India and Fit India.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah presents the President’s Colours to Puducherry Police
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah presented the President's Colours to the Puducherry Police, the highest honour for any disciplined force in India, at a ceremony attended by Puducherry's Lieutenant Governor and Chief Minister. Shah highlighted the force's role in safeguarding Puducherry's internal security since the DGP post was created in 1963, its service during COVID-19, and announced that the Modi government has given Puducherry ₹13,762 crore in development funds since 2014, compared to ₹3,500 crore given between 1950 and 2014.

title: Government Strengthens Monitoring of Funds Earmarked for Welfare and Development of Scheduled Castes under DAPSC
summary: The Government told the Rajya Sabha that 38 Ministries/Departments earmark funds under the Development Action Plan for Scheduled Castes (DAPSC), formerly the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (SCSP), as per NITI Aayog's 2017 guidelines. Data since 2020-21 shows actual expenditure has consistently fallen short of Revised Estimates, with utilisation ranging from 81.61% (2020-21) to a peak of 93.83% (2023-24), and 85.65% in 2025-26. The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment monitors fund utilisation through periodic review meetings and has directed all 38 ministries to appoint nodal officers for financial and physical monitoring of DAPSC funds.

title: ₹1,178.20 Crore Central Share Released to Karnataka Under Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students During Last Three Financial Years
summary: The Union Government informed the Rajya Sabha that ₹1,178.20 crore was released as Central share to Karnataka under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC students over the last three financial years: ₹421.08 crore (2023-24), ₹422.90 crore (2024-25) and ₹334.22 crore (2025-26). Minister of State Ramdas Athawale gave these details in reply to an Unstarred Question. The scheme is implemented via Direct Benefit Transfer since 2021-22, contingent on states uploading verified data on the National Scholarship Portal.

title: From Financial Constraints to Educational Aspirations: How Scholarship Support Helped Ganesh Kumar Pursue His B.Tech Education
summary: This PIB release profiles Ganesh Kumar, a 21-year-old B.Tech II Year student from the OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) category, who received ₹87,000 in scholarship support in 2026 under a Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment scheme. The financial assistance helped reduce the economic burden on his family and enabled him to continue his higher education despite financial constraints.

title: From Financial Constraints to Educational Aspirations: How Scholarship Support Helped 	Anu Priya Pursue Her B.Tech Education
summary: This PIB release highlights the case of Anu Priya, a 20-year-old OBC-category B.Tech II Year student from a financially weaker rural family, who received ₹7,50,000 in scholarship support during 2024-2026 through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). The financial assistance covered tuition fees, books, study materials and other educational expenses, helping her continue her education despite her family's low annual income (₹99,000 earlier, now around ₹1,20,000). The release presents her story as an example of how government scholarship schemes support students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds in pursuing higher education.

title: From Financial Constraints to Technical Aspirations: How Scholarship Support Helped Yarra Mahesh Pursue His B.Tech Education
summary: Yarra Mahesh, a 21-year-old B.Tech second-year student from the Gen-EWS (Economically Weaker Section) category, received a scholarship of ₹52,540 in 2025 under a Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment scheme. The funds covered college fees, hostel and food expenses, travel, study materials, internet costs, and a laptop, easing his family's financial burden. With this support, he pursued technical skill development and co-authored a research paper on Skin Cancer Classification using AI/ML, currently under publication.

title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan launches ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Abhiyan’ in Andaman & Nicobar Islands
summary: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan launched the 'Har Ghar Tiranga Abhiyan' by hoisting the National Flag at Flag Point, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, on August Kranti Diwas (August 9, 2026), marking the anniversary of the 1942 Quit India Movement. He addressed a State Function at DBRAIT Auditorium, invoking the islands' freedom struggle legacy including Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's 1943 flag-hoisting and the sacrifices at Cellular Jail, and spoke about the Great Nicobar Island Development Project strengthening India's maritime capabilities.

title: NBA disburses around Rs. 3.79 crore under Access and Benefit Sharing mechanism to 33 States/UTs and National Institutes

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) has disbursed nearly Rs. 3.79 crore under the Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) mechanism to 33 State Biodiversity Boards/UT Biodiversity Councils, ICAR-NBPGR, and the Hisar Bovine Sperm Station and Research Centre. The funds were realised from companies like Bayer Science and Innovation, HM Clause India, and Advanta Enterprises for accessing vegetable, oilseed and Sahiwal cattle germplasm, plus a contribution from Sri Lanka's government for Sahiwal semen access. Madhya Pradesh, West Bengal and Odisha received the largest shares, and cumulative NBA ABS disbursements have now crossed Rs. 166 crore.

title: Prime Minister pays homage to brave participants of the Quit India Movement
summary: On 9 August 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute via a post on X to all participants of the Quit India Movement, commemorating its anniversary. He stated that the movement, inspired by Mahatma Gandhi's leadership, infused new energy into India's freedom struggle and reflected the unwavering resolve of Indians to end colonial rule.

title: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
summary: CPGRAMS (Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System) is the Government of India's single-window digital platform connecting all Central Ministries, Departments, States and UTs for citizen grievance redressal. Since 2014, annual grievances handled rose from about 3 lakh to 27 lakh in 2024, average disposal time fell from 157 to 15 days, and Grievance Redressal Officers grew from about 10,000 to over 1.1 lakh. Recent reforms include the 2022 10-Step Reform Programme, a 21-day resolution mandate (August 2024 guidelines), the AI voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' (launched 30 May 2026), and the upcoming NextGen CPGRAMS with AI-based routing and validation features.
